## What this changes

## Constitution check

Every article of `.specify/memory/constitution.md` is checked before review.

- [ ] No media leaves the device; only subtitle text may, after explicit confirmation (art. I)
- [ ] Every network request is user-initiated and visible (art. II)
- [ ] The flow works with no model configured (art. III)
- [ ] Every clip or result carries the evidence behind it (art. IV)
- [ ] Model output is never treated as a timestamp (art. V)
- [ ] No model call where deterministic code can do the job (art. VI)
- [ ] Same input and settings produce the same output (art. VII)
- [ ] Runs end to end on a real file, not on scaffolding (art. VIII)
- [ ] Failures are reported where the work happens, never silently (art. IX)
- [ ] Acceptance criteria checked against `eval/`, with the recordings named (art. X)
